about: Hand-researched outcomes for finished Parkinson's disease studies, used by scripts/fetch-registry.mjs. Keyed by NCT ID. verdict is one of: Met primary endpoint, Missed primary endpoint, No benefit shown (exploratory study with no formal primary endpoint), Mixed results, Inconclusive, Stopped: no benefit, Stopped: safety, Stopped: slow enrollment, Stopped: business or funding, Extension or access study, Safety study, Descriptive results (no comparison or formal test, e.g. a feasibility or physiology study), Not a treatment study, No results found. summary says what happened in plain words; source is the checked publication or report it rests on (null only for facts that are part of the registry record itself or widely documented, e.g. a drug's market withdrawal). ignorePublications: true hides publications the registry links as results when they are really background or a different study. Studies not listed here get an automatic outcome from the registry (its stop reason, posted results and linked publications).

NCT00256204.summary: ADAGIO delayed-start trial: rasagiline 1 mg met all three primary endpoints, consistent with slowing progression, but 2 mg did not, so a disease-modifying effect wasn't established.

NCT00449865.summary: NET-PD LS-1: stopped early for futility; creatine taken for at least five years did not slow clinical progression.

NCT00740714.summary: QE3: stopped early for futility; high-dose coenzyme Q10 gave no evidence of benefit in early Parkinson's.

NCT02168842.summary: STEADY-PD III: isradipine did not slow progression of early Parkinson's over 36 months (change in UPDRS parts I-III).

NCT02642393.summary: SURE-PD3: stopped early for futility; inosine raised blood urate but did not slow progression of early Parkinson's.

NCT04232969.summary: Exenatide-PD3: exenatide once weekly for two years did not slow motor progression compared with placebo.

NCT00040404.summary: PRECEPT: the mixed-lineage kinase inhibitor CEP-1347 failed to delay disability and the trial was stopped for futility.

NCT03100149.summary: PASADENA: prasinezumab did not change overall progression (MDS-UPDRS total) over 52 weeks; signals on motor-exam secondary measures led to the follow-on PADOVA trial.

NCT03318523.summary: SPARK: cinpanemab did not slow progression compared with placebo and the trial was ended early.

NCT01971242.summary: Exenatide once weekly for 48 weeks gave better off-medication motor scores than placebo 12 weeks after stopping; the larger Phase 3 trial later failed.

NCT03439943.summary: LixiPark: lixisenatide gave less motor-score progression than placebo over 12 months in early Parkinson's, with nausea and other gut side effects.

NCT03205488.summary: NILO-PD: nilotinib was reasonably tolerated but showed no clinical benefit and reached the brain only at low levels; the authors did not support further testing.

NCT02655315.summary: FAIRPARK-II: in newly diagnosed patients not on levodopa, deferiprone was followed by worse progression than placebo over 36 weeks.

NCT01280123.summary: FS-ZONE futility trial: pioglitazone was unlikely to slow progression of early Parkinson's and was not recommended for a Phase 3 trial.

NCT01560754.summary: NIC-PD: transdermal nicotine for a year did not slow progression of early Parkinson's.

NCT04777331.summary: PADOVA: prasinezumab narrowly missed its primary endpoint (time to confirmed motor progression), with supportive trends; a Phase 3 trial (PARAISO) followed.
